name: Nigel Farage
bio: Leader of Reform UK and MP for Clacton from July 2024 until his resignation on 7 July 2026. Previously leader of UKIP and the Brexit Party, and a Member of the European Parliament for South East England from 1999 to 2020. He won Clacton in 2024 with 46.2% of the vote, on the largest swing recorded at any UK general election.
whyStanding: Farage resigned his seat while under investigation by the Parliamentary Commissioner for Standards over undeclared financial support, saying he had "done no wrongdoing and followed the rules" and describing the investigations as an "establishment hit job". He is standing again to seek a fresh mandate from Clacton voters.

name: Count Binface
bio: A satirical "intergalactic" novelty candidate, the alter ego of comedian Jon Harvey. Count Binface has previously stood against senior politicians in their own seats, including Boris Johnson in Uxbridge, Rishi Sunak in Richmond and Keir Starmer in Holborn & St Pancras, campaigning on a deliberately absurd manifesto.
whyStanding: With the main opposition parties declining to field candidates against Farage, Count Binface announced he would stand and was quickly framed in coverage and betting markets as the highest-profile challenger on the ballot. He has questioned whether rivals are "running scared".

name: Laurence Fox
bio: Actor and founder and leader of the Reclaim Party, which he set up in 2020. He stood as a candidate for Mayor of London in 2021.
whyStanding: Fox has announced he will contest the by-election for the Reclaim Party.

name: Kai Stephens
bio: The British Democrats' candidate for the by-election. The British Democrats are a small nationalist party.
whyStanding: Stephens has been announced as the British Democrats' candidate for Clacton.

name: Adham Alkhatip
bio: The Forward Party's candidate for the by-election.
whyStanding: Alkhatip has been announced as the Forward Party's candidate for Clacton.

name: Ollie Granger
bio: An independent candidate standing in the by-election.
whyStanding: Granger has announced he will stand as an independent.

name: Luke Worley
bio: An independent candidate standing in the by-election.
